record.context_brief: complete Kähler-Einstein metrics on unbounded pseudoconvex domains
record.original_question: Under what conditions does an unbounded pseudoconvex domain admit a complete Kähler-Einstein metric?

evidence.quote: Question 2.18. When does an unbounded pseudo-convex domain admit a complete Kähler-Einstein metric ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ be an unbounded pseudoconvex domain (i.e., $\Omega$ is open, connected, and admits a continuous plurisubharmonic exhaustion function, but is not bounded). A Kähler metric $g$ on $\Omega$ is called Kähler-Einstein if its Ricci form satisfies $\mathrm{Ric}(g) = c\,\omega_g$ for some real constant $c$, where $\omega_g$ is the Kähler form of $g$; the metric is complete if the underlying Riemannian metric is geodesically complete.

For bounded pseudoconvex domains in $\mathbb{C}^n$, it is classical (Cheng–Yau, Mok–Yau) that a unique complete Kähler-Einstein metric of negative Ricci curvature always exists. The problem is to determine the analogous existence theory in the unbounded setting:

Find necessary and sufficient conditions on an unbounded pseudoconvex domain $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ which guarantee that $\Omega$ admits a complete Kähler-Einstein metric.
artifact.category_tag: Complete Kähler-Einstein metrics on pseudoconvex domains
artifact.status_search_result: While complete Kähler-Einstein metrics of negative Ricci curvature are known to exist on all bounded pseudoconvex domains (Cheng–Yau, Mok–Yau), and partial results exist for unbounded strictly pseudoconvex domains, e.g. via positivity of the canonical bundle (Coevering) or curvature hypotheses (Wu–Yau), recent work (2023–2025) on Kähler-Einstein Bergman metrics and iterative constructions indicates that a complete characterization for general unbounded pseudoconvex domains remains open.

status_evidence.title: An iterative construction of complete Kähler–Einstein metrics
status_evidence.snippet: Mok-Yau extended Cheng-Yau's conclusion to any bounded pseudoconvex domain... a bounded domain is holomorphic iff there exists a complete Kähler-Einstein metric with negative Ricci curvature on it.
status_evidence.claim: Bounded case is fully resolved; unbounded case remains under active investigation.

status_evidence.title: Kähler-Einstein Bergman metrics on pseudoconvex domains of dimension two
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work studies Kähler-Einstein Bergman metrics on pseudoconvex domains.
status_evidence.claim: Active research on KE metrics on (possibly unbounded) pseudoconvex domains continues.

status_evidence.title: Invariant metrics on unbounded strongly pseudoconvex domains
status_evidence.snippet: Invariant metrics on unbounded strongly pseudoconvex domains with non-compact automorphism group.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results in special unbounded cases, no general characterization.
